paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: Performance of when implemented with base LLMs ranging from 1B to 8B parameters.
model_annotation: This line chart displays the accuracy percentage of three base LLMs—Llama3-1B, Llama3-3B, and Llama3-8B—as a function of the compression factor (c), which ranges from 1 to 5 on a linear scale with integer tick marks. The y-axis represents accuracy in percent, ranging from 30% to 70%, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10%. The Llama3-1B model is represented by a brown line with circular markers that decreases from 48% at c=1 to 27% at c=5. The Llama3-3B model is shown by a maroon line with circular markers, decreasing from 63% at c=1 to 39% at c=5. The Llama3-8B model is depicted by a purple line with circular markers, decreasing from 70% at c=1 to 43% at c=5. All three lines exhibit a consistent downward trend across the compression factor range.

model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage of three base LLMs—Llama3-1B, Llama3-3B, and Llama3-8B—as a function of the compression factor (c), which ranges from 1 to 5 on the linear x-axis. The y-axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 30% to 70% on a linear scale. The plot displays three distinct lines: the Llama3-1B model is represented by a brown line with circular markers; the Llama3-3B model is shown as a maroon line with circular markers; and the Llama3-8B model is depicted by a purple line with circular markers. Across the entire range of compression factors, all three models exhibit a consistent downward trend in accuracy. Specifically, the Llama3-8B model starts at 70% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and declines to 43% at a compression factor of 5. The Llama3-3B model begins at 63% accuracy at compression factor 1 and decreases to 39% at compression factor 5. The Llama3-1B model starts at 48% accuracy at compression factor 1 and falls to 27% at compression factor 5. Each line is marked with data points at every integer value of the compression factor from 1 to 5.
